For the first time, Arkansans will not have to pay taxes on overtime thanks to the Working Families Tax Cut.

No taxes on tips, no taxes on Social Security, and no taxes on overtime are three huge wins for working families.

Every single Democrat voted against these tax cuts.

This police week, I'm proud to stand with Arkansas's law enforcement officers who put their lives on the line to keep us safe. 

The left prefers criminals to cops, but I will continue to back the blue and oppose any legislation that softens criminal penalties.

Platner truly is a lying fraud.


Garrett Exner (@Exner_Garrett)

Can confirm, over 14 years in the Marine Corps, mostly in special operations, and I’ve never seen a Totenkopf tattoo on a Marine, ever.

Platner pointing to Scout Sniper lightning bolts is misdirection. 

Platner was not a sniper and his tattoo is from concentration camp guards.



— https://nitter.net/Exner_Garrett/status/2052781831053775308#m

Fake oysterman/silver spoon liberal Graham Platner now claims he had NO IDEA his Nazi tattoo was a Nazi tattoo. 

Of course he also has a deep hatred for Israel and goes on podcasts with antisemites. 

What a remarkable coincidence.

Re. Graham Platner and his Nazi tattoo: 

I knew more than a few infantrymen with tattoos. 

But I didn’t know any who had a tattoo honoring Nazi concentration camp guards like Platner. 

Graham Platner is a lying fraud.

It's ironic that Jack Smith is smearing President Trump’s DOJ. 

It's Jack Smith who weaponized the DOJ to be the legal wing of the Kamala Harris campaign. He secretly seized lawmaker's records with farfetched legal theories.   

Smith's lawfare must never happen again.
